notes.title: Custom control inputs in latest patch!
notes.content:
We're listening to you guys!

Patch for version 1.2 is now live, includes the ability to custom map your control inputs.  Default inputs are; Fire Left (Left Ctrl), Fire Right (Left Alt), Bomb (Left Shift), JumpLeft (Left Arrow), JumpRight (Right Arrow).

You can remap these on the start up dialog screen before you start the game, click on the inputs tab.
